description: All-time best powerlifting performances from the OpenPowerlifting database: the top lifters by total, squat, bench, deadlift or Dots points for a sex and equipment category, optionally narrowed by weight_class (e.g. "83", "84+"), federation, age_class (e.g. "24-34"), tested (drug-tested meets only) and year. One row per lifter (their best qualifying entry), with the meet and date. Lifts are in kilograms. total is only ranked over full three-lift (SBD) entries unless event is given. These are the best entries IN THE DATA, filtered as asked -- not an official federation record list (federations apply their own rules and equipment definitions). Nothing matching returns found:false with data_as_of.

event.description: SBD, B, D, BD, SB... Default SBD for lift=total; none otherwise.

name: opl_records
